name: Fukuoka

flag.description: A white plum blossom on a blue field, drawn from the hiragana ふく (fuku).
flag.symbolism: The plum is the prefectural flower, and ふく begins the prefecture's name; together they stand for peace and growth.

hook: Fukuoka's white plum blossom on blue is woven from ふく (fuku).
trivia: Dazaifu Tenmangū shrine in Fukuoka is famous for its thousands of plum trees.
Fukuoka City, home of Hakata ramen, is the largest city in Kyūshū.
